in_sanskrit.name: Sanga
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Song, Melody
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sanga एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sanga originated from the Sanskrit word ‘Sang’ which means ‘Song’ or ‘Melody’. In Hindu culture, music and dance are considered to be an integral part of life. Sanga is a name for those who are harmonious, creative, and can bring peace to any environment.
